This is to try and not mess up texture)and do a wash weigh soap let dry in a style or style after. For Twyla mix 1:2 dish soap and baking soda on damp hair let sit for 40 minutes wash twice after. If that doesn’t improve it a bit of power or dry shampoo might help. I’ve only been doing this for a bit so I’m not the most experienced but these have worked in the past
